choices.reversible: Undo / Restart turn may take it back: nothing hidden was revealed and the opponent did not decide anything.
choices.irreversible: Cannot be taken back: it reveals hidden information (a draw, a reveal, a search) or the opponent has to answer. Restart turn stops after it.
choices.depends: Reversible in some cases only (say when in the note, e.g. display card vs deck card).
choices.not_applicable: Not a player decision (an internal step of the engine): nothing to decide.

items.label: choose_map
items.description: Pick a map (setup).
items.why: Before the game.

items.label: draft_pick
items.description: Pick a variant in the action card draft (both players at once).
items.why: Can be changed until the other player has chosen; final after.

items.label: draft_keep
items.description: Keep 2 of 3 variants.
items.why: Same as draft_pick.

items.label: initial_discard
items.description: Discard 4 of the 8 dealt cards.
items.why: Both choose at the same time: reversible until both have chosen.

items.label: choose_action_card
items.description: Choose an action card (and spend X tokens).
items.why: Nothing hidden is revealed. If the break advance starts a break, see break_start.

items.label: sponsor_side
items.description: Side action of a Sponsors card variant.
items.why: Cards involved are public (discard, snap from the display).

items.label: self_clever
items.description: Self-clever Association: do nothing and act again.

items.label: take_instead
items.description: A card instead of the donation.
items.why: From the deck: irreversible; from the display: reversible.

items.label: skip_extra
items.description: Decline the optional second action.

items.label: skip_action
items.description: Put an action card on slot 1 and gain an X token.

items.label: play_animal
items.description: Play an animal into an enclosure.
items.why: The card is public; its on-play effects have their own rows.

items.label: place_building
items.description: Place a building.
items.why: Placement bonuses have their own rows.

items.label: finish_build
items.description: Stop building.

items.label: take_card
items.description: Take a card from the display or draw from the deck.
items.why: Deck draw irreversible, display reversible.

items.label: discard_cards
items.description: Discard cards from the hand.
items.why: Public discard pile.

items.label: play_sponsor
items.description: Play a sponsor card.
items.why: Effects have their own rows.

items.label: sponsor_break
items.description: Sponsors action alternative: advance the break and take money.
items.why: Irreversible if it triggers a break.

items.label: finish_sponsors
items.description: Stop playing sponsors.

items.label: skip_effect
items.description: Decline an optional pending effect.

items.label: association_task
items.description: Perform one association task.
items.why: Tasks that draw (universities with a search) are irreversible.

items.label: finish_animals
items.description: Stop playing animals.

items.label: finish_association
items.description: Stop performing association tasks.

items.label: donate
items.description: Make a donation.

items.label: upgrade_action_card
items.description: Flip an action card to level II.

items.label: choose_effect
items.description: Resolve one of the pending effects (see the effect rows below).
items.why: As the effect it resolves.

items.label: skip
items.description: Decline an optional effect.

items.label: confirm_turn (new)
items.description: End the turn: the display is refilled, a break may start, the turn passes.
items.why: The display refill reveals draw pile cards. Everything before it can be undone, nothing after.

items.label: build
items.description: Place a (free) building.

items.label: take
items.description: Take a card: deck or display.
items.why: Deck: irreversible. Display: reversible.

items.label: gain
items.description: Money, appeal, conservation, reputation, X tokens.
items.why: Reputation and conservation thresholds open their own rows.

items.label: reveal (Hunter, Perception, Scuba Dive)
items.description: Reveal the X topmost cards and keep some.
items.why: The cards were revealed to the opponent.

items.label: sell
items.description: Discard cards for money (Sun Bathing).
items.why: Public discard.

items.label: mark
items.description: Place a mark cube.

items.label: marketing
items.description: Play a sponsor / bonus through Marketing.

items.label: donation
items.description: Donate.

items.label: digging
items.description: Discard a hand card, draw one (or discard a display card).
items.why: Drawing from the deck: irreversible. Display part: reversible.

items.label: scavenge
items.description: Draw from the discard pile / deck and keep.
items.why: Draws from the deck.

items.label: glide / glide_gain
items.description: Glide: discard cards for a gain.

items.label: shark
items.description: Shark Attack: discard sea animals of the display.
items.why: The display refill comes at the end of the turn.

items.label: symbiosis
items.description: Use the ability of another sea animal.
items.why: As the copied ability.

items.label: cut_down
items.description: Remove a building.

items.label: trade
items.description: Trade X tokens and money.

items.label: extra_shift
items.description: Take a worker back.

items.label: assertion
items.description: Take an unused base conservation project.
items.why: The unused pool is public.

items.label: pilfer
items.description: Pilfering: the opponent gives a card or money.
items.why: The opponent has to answer.

items.label: venom / constrict
items.description: Give Venom or Constriction tokens.
items.why: Opponent's payment decisions are irreversible.

items.label: hypnosis
items.description: Use an action card of the opponent.
items.why: Irreversible once the opponent's card does something hidden.

items.label: pay_appeal
items.description: Pay appeal for an effect.

items.label: jumping
items.description: Advance the break token and gain money.
items.why: Irreversible if the break starts.

items.label: upgrade / threshold2
items.description: Upgrade an action card or hire a worker.

items.label: threshold_bonus
items.description: Conservation 5 / 8: pick one of the bonuses.
items.why: As the bonus picked (a draw is irreversible).

items.label: endgame_discard
items.description: Conservation 10: discard an endgame card.
items.why: Both players at once: reversible until both have chosen.

items.label: adapt
items.description: Draw final scoring / base projects and discard.
items.why: Draws from the endgame deck.

items.label: break_discard
items.description: Discard down to the hand limit in a break.
items.why: Both at once; reversible until both have chosen.

items.label: take_tile
items.description: Take a partner zoo / university tile.
items.why: Replenishing is at the end of the break.

items.label: archaeologist
items.description: Archaeologist.
items.why: Check the rule.

items.label: income_appeal / income_kiosk / income_map / income_sponsor
items.description: Choices of the break income.
items.why: Money reversible, cards from the deck irreversible.

items.label: rep_bonus
items.description: Reputation track bonus.
items.why: A card to take: see take.

items.label: store
items.description: Store a card (map 11).
items.why: Nobody else learns anything but a count.

items.label: move_in / continent / multiplier
items.description: Map specific moves (map 9, map 4).

items.label: wave
items.description: Remove the first display card and replenish.
items.why: The replenish reveals a draw pile card.

items.label: release
items.description: Release an animal for a project.

items.label: project_bonus / tutor / reef
items.description: Conservation project rewards.
items.why: Tutor (search) is irreversible.

items.label: waza
items.description: Take the first animal of a size from the deck.
items.why: Search of the draw pile.

items.label: reposition
items.description: Remove up to 3 buildings and place them again.

items.label: boost / slot1
items.description: Move an action card to slot 1 or 5.

items.label: enlarge
items.description: Enlarge an enclosure.

items.label: expedition
items.description: Send a person away or Scuba Dive 3.
items.why: Scuba Dive reveals cards: irreversible.

items.label: ability (Sprint, Monkey Gang, Scavenging, ...)
items.description: Deferred abilities that draw.
items.why: They draw from the deck.

items.label: search_discard
items.description: Take a card from the discard pile.
items.why: The pile is public.

items.label: Display refill
items.description: At the end of the turn.
items.why: Part of confirm_turn.

items.label: Break starts
items.description: The break token reaches the end: income, discards, refill.
items.why: The game moves on for both players.

items.label: Shuffle / reshuffle
items.description: A deck is shuffled.
items.why: Reveals nothing but cannot be undone.
